correctness.rationale: With m=(p-1)/2 square frequencies, Gauss sums give E_ab=-1+i sqrt(p) chi(b-a) off-diagonal and zero diagonal. All four-vertex tournaments give three distinct exact Hermitian characteristic polynomials PT, PD and PS; source symbolic checker and exact double-regular Paley tournament count establish all four-subset multiplicities. In an independent symbolic calculation PD expands to t^4-6(p+1)t^2+8t+9p^2+6p-3 and PT(-r)-PS(r)=-16(p+r). PT(-R_D)=-8p(p+sqrt(3p+4)+2)<0 and root asymmetry prove its least root dominates the absolute roots of D, S and its own positive roots when p>=11, with p=7 no transitive sets and S maximal; p=11 δ4=0.9025414700217169 and p=7 δ4=1.2005597106277182 from independent symbolic/numeric tests. Simple leading polynomial gives (1+sqrt(2))/sqrt(p)+O(p^-1). No all-prime conclusion relies on four finite checker primes.
